perItemFindings.one_line: Delivered tier subfield < floor field; not salvageable within scope.

verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The global minimax expansion is supported by a separate schedule-uniform estimator and all-design Bayes-prior sandwich, so the open uniform-singular-bridge question does not leave the stated sharp constant or allocation frontier unproved. What remains unproved is the stronger claim that the stratified face/corner experiment itself arises through a uniform liminf-and-recovery comparison across transverse eta strata; the note delivers only the tangent program, spectral calculation, and global value bounds. The contribution is confined to one fixed three-arm contrast with a common bounded outcome interval, and the nominally computable finite-orbit certificates are not accompanied by actual calculations, code, or finite-sample evidence showing the practical size of the second-order gain. The related-work prose also repeatedly calls recent arXiv preprints “published” and relies rhetorically on a non-archival repository parent, although the essential orbit reduction is reproved in the note. These scope, evidence, and positioning limitations keep the projected paper below the strongest leading-journal contributions despite clearing the field-tier floor. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.9 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

HALTED AT TRIAGE: the math panel returned `revise` and its findings were never repaired, so this note is NOT established as mathematically sound — do not bank it as downgraded on this verdict alone. Open findings: wrong_fisher_information@lem:broad-prior-coercivity
